rationale.conceptual: The method (DFT with spin-orbit coupling, force theorem) is an established, non-trivial protocol that requires careful selection of pseudopotentials, k-points, and self-consistent field convergence. It goes beyond simple library calls but is well-documented and routine in computational materials science.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a scalar-relativistic SCF calculation, two non-self-consistent SOC runs, and energy extraction. While the steps are sequential and short, the solver must install/open a DFT code, set up input files correctly, and ensure convergence, which introduces moderate engineering complexity beyond a simple script.
